mapper.sql: s.id, s.enterprise_id, s.application_id, ja.candidate_id AS candidate_user_id, ja.job_id, s.template_id, s.interviewer_user_id, j.title AS job_title, s.interview_time, s.interview_type, s.status, s.status_reason, s.version, s.created_at, s.updated_at
FROM interview_schedule s JOIN job_applications ja ON ja.id = s.application_id AND ja.is_deleted = FALSE JOIN jobs j ON j.id = ja.job_id AND j.is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT s.id FROM interview_schedule s JOIN job_applications ja ON ja.id = s.application_id AND ja.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE s.is_deleted = FALSE AND ja.candidate_id = #{candidateUserId}
